title: Appeals Desk Note — Appealing a Denied Mobility Equipment Rental Month
content:
# Appealing a Denied Rental Month — Mobility Equipment

**Note.** A denied Mobility Equipment rental month may be appealed through a redetermination appeal request naming it as the related line. The appeal is filed no later than the coverage class's redetermination window days after the denial is received, counting calendar days from the day after the denied line's adjudication date with the boundary day included. A denial for cap reached, same or similar or inpatient stay is not appealed; a prior authorization missing, face-to-face missing or home assessment missing denial is appealed only when the proof was on file before delivery.

## The window

- **Length:** the redetermination window days of the coverage class.
- **Clock starts:** the day after the adjudication date of the denied line, on the system's billing record.
- **Comparison:** filed no later than the last day of the window; that day itself counts.

## Denial reasons

| Denial reason | Appeal |
|---|---|
| cap reached | not appealed |
| same or similar | not appealed |
| inpatient stay | not appealed |
| prior authorization missing | appealed only when the proof was on file before delivery |
| face-to-face missing | appealed only when the proof was on file before delivery |
| home assessment missing | appealed only when the proof was on file before delivery |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 120-day window, adjudication date 10 January)

Day 1 of the count is 11 January, and day 120 is 10 May. An appeal filed on 10 May is in time; an appeal filed on 11 May is late.
